text:
People Ops: New pilot: Flexible half-day PTO + staggered return-to-work leave. Effective Mon Jun 1. You can now request partial-day time off in 2-hour increments (min 2h), or a staggered RTW plan after a leave >4w (e.g., 60% week for 2 weeks). Were adding UI support, calendar blocks, and payroll tags. FAQ + how-to: https://intranet.redwood.ai/policies/flexible-pto :seedling:

Maya (HR Lead): Short Q&A Wed 9:00 PT — will demo the new request flows. Pilot initially open to Eng and Product; opt-in link in the doc.

Ajay (Payroll): Heads up for managers: partial-day PTO will be tagged as `pto.partial` and can be exported as hourly adjustments. For staggered RTW plans well include a `ramp.plan` CSV export with start/end dates and percent FTE. Payroll will need at least one full pay-period notice to process adjustments without manual interventions.

Niko (Eng Manager): For staggered RTW, can team leads request a temporary change to on-call rotations? That would help coverage.

People Ops: Yes — manager override flow allows temporary rota changes. When you submit the ramp plan you can check "adjust team rota" and the system will create a suggested on-call swap list and notify Eng Oncall.

Jess (IC): If I request a 4-hour block mid-day, does my calendar show two events or a single block? How does Slack OOO update?

People Ops: Calendar integration will create a single OOO block for the requested hours and set Slack status to "OOO (partial)" with end time. Example calendar event title: `OOO - partial: 4h (PM)` and description includes PTO type and approval ID. Slack status example: `OOO (partial) until 15:00`

Ajay (Payroll): Quick API example for self-serve and automation:```bash
curl -X POST https://payroll.redwood.ai/v1/pto \n  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOK" \n  -d '{"user":"jess","date":"2026-06-14","partial_hours":4,"type":"pto","reason":"dr appt"}'
```

People Ops: Were also adding a manager digest for partial-day approvals and a separate feed for ramp plans. Digests are configurable in Manager Settings.

Niko (Eng Manager): Any limits on how many partial-days per quarter? We dont want people gaming it instead of taking full days when needed.

Maya (HR Lead): Pilot limits: up to 10 partial-day instances per quarter per employee by default. Managers can request exceptions via People Ops. We will review usage and feedback before making this permanent.

Jess (IC): Carbon-copy question: do partial-days affect accrual calculations?

Ajay (Payroll): Partial hours deduct from PTO balance on an hourly basis. Accrual schedule unchanged. The UI shows remaining balance in hours and days.

People Ops: Accessibility & compliance notes: staggered RTW plans will include an "accommodation" checkbox for medical/ADA reasons; Legal will be included on escalations. Also well keep immutable logs: request_id, user, manager_approval, partial_hours, ramp_percent, timestamps. Sample log:```log
req=pt-2405129001 user=jess partial_h=4 approver=niko status=approved ts=2405129055
```

calendar-bot: Reminder: Flexible PTO demo Wed 09:00 PT, All-Hands room + Zoom.

Niko (Eng Manager): Thanks, this looks promising. One ask: can we turn on partial-day visibility per-team so PMs know capacity?

People Ops: Plan includes an "team availability" overlay in the calendar view for pilot teams. PMs/EMs can opt-in. Well send pilot opt-in form after the demo.

Maya (HR Lead): Timeline: demo Wed; pilot opt-in opens next Mon; pilot runs 8 weeks; company decision after pilot review. Questions or edge-cases, DM People Ops.
